column1: # The three magic refusals the suite has never put on a stock screen.
# result table publishes all three, and `magic-mix-and-cast` establishes the
# input vocabulary that reaches them - the mixer commits on a second `m`, and
# a cast is `c`, the caster confirm, the spell code, and Return.
# Each of the three is a different gate, taken in the order the spec lists
# them: a cast with no charge, a commit with no reagent toggled, and a commit
# whose quantity exceeds what the party carries.
# Vas Mani is the vehicle. It is not the spell the seed carries mixed - that
# is In Lor - so its charge counter starts at zero, and its reagent set
# includes ginseng and spider silk in quantities the shipped party does not
# requires-seed: the party standing on the Britannia overworld

column4: Casting a spell with no charge mixed
The reagent surface with nothing toggled
Committing nine of a reagent the party lacks
